copy.blurb:
A +27.0pp gap on the Croatia side. Croatia v Ghana in FIFA World Cup 2026 is the match. The model has Croatia stronger than the market does — that's the reason this fires as a Pick rather than a Pass.

Public Elo rates Croatia 240 points higher than the other side (Croatia 1860, Ghana 1620). The match model's logistic translates that Elo gap directly into a win-probability. Both Elo numbers are pulled live from the public Elo source. No host, home-ground, or altitude adjustments apply here; the prior reads straight from Elo.

Three-way split from the model: Croatia to win at 67%, the draw at 16%, and Ghana to win at 17%. The home side reads 67% on this distribution — the model's central case for Croatia.

On the same three-way, Kalshi: Croatia to win at 40%, the draw at 26%, and Ghana to win at 22%. Kalshi has Croatia at 40%, which prices out at American odds of +147; the model has the same side at 67%. The +27.0pp gap across them is the disagreement we're surfacing.

Bootstrap discipline matters most on the longshots — wide bands on small point estimates collapse the Pick rate fast. On Croatia the lower bound is 58%, which keeps the lower-bound gap at +17.8pp against the market — past +3pp, so the Pick clears. The claim is narrow: on this fixture, on this side, the price is below what the underlying read supports. We don't argue the market is broadly wrong — across the priced field the model and the line agree more often than they disagree. We surface the ones where they don't.

The read above is the most recent one, not a frozen call. With kickoff 36 days out, the refresh is weekly until we cross five days, then daily, then hourly inside the final day. Injury news, the actual XI, and conditions at kickoff all change what the model sees. We re-publish on every refresh. The page shows what the engine reads; what to do with that information is a reader's call.
drivers: Bootstrap lower-bound on the Croatia side still clears the Pick threshold.
Editorial analysis only — Odds Primer does not place trades or recommend a wager.
Pre-match Elo gives Croatia a stronger prior than the Kalshi line implies.
The +27.0pp gap clears the Desk's 3 percentage point threshold for a Pick.
copy.summary: Croatia are favourites on the market at 40% — and the model thinks the market is still underrating them. Our prior reads 67%, a +27.0pp upgrade that crosses the Pick threshold comfortably.
